name: Mai Tai
title: Mai Tai (The "I've Been Here Before")
tagline: You've been to Hawaii. You will mention it.
description: You're the friend who already knows the difference between a tourist Mai Tai and a real one, and you will, unfortunately, say the word orgeat out loud. You packed linen on purpose. You have a pineapple opinion. You told three people on Chestnut this week that "Hawaii just hits different" like that's a take and not a weather report. At Ryan and Natalie's wedding you look extremely correct holding this drink — classic, slightly extra, quietly pleased you didn't order the blue one. The group chat's designated adult until 10pm. After that you're still a Mai Tai. You just get louder about the rum.
share_text: I got Mai Tai in Ryan & Natalie's wedding drink quiz. Translation: I've been to Hawaii before and I will mention it. Classic. Slightly extra. Correct.
html_blurb: Classic, reliable, and just extra enough to mention you've been to Hawaii before. You're the correct choice and you know it.

name: Miami Vice
title: Miami Vice (Can't Pick a Lane)
tagline: Half strawberry, half piña colada, 100% "why not both."
description: You did not fly from SFO to a Hawaiian wedding to make a decision. You want the dance floor AND the bar, the sweet AND the rum, the "I'm being so good" AND the second one. The Miami Vice is two drinks in a trench coat and so are you. You'll vanish for twenty minutes, reappear with glow, and insist you're hydrating. Chaotic good. The plus-one who somehow has Advil, a backup lipstick, and no memory of agreeing to either. Ryan and Natalie planned a beautiful night. You planned to be in two places at once. Congratulations. You won.
share_text: I got Miami Vice. I cannot pick one thing. I want the dance floor AND the bar. See you in the blur.
html_blurb: You wanted both, so you got both. Half sweet, half chaos, fully booked on the dance floor.

name: Lava Flow
title: Lava Flow (Main Character, Soft Launch)
tagline: If it doesn't photograph, did you even attend?
description: You're not here for a drink. You're here for a moment. The Lava Flow is pink, dramatic, and slightly too pretty to finish before the photo, which is exactly your brand. You will find the good light. You will say "wait, one more" without irony. Sweet, photogenic, and emotionally available for the vows in a way that will surprise nobody who follows you. Ryan and Natalie look incredible. You look like you belong in the carousel. The group chat will receive the photo before you take a sip. That's not a flaw. That's production value.
share_text: I got Lava Flow. Photogenic. Dramatic. Sweet. If it doesn't make the recap, did I even go?
html_blurb: Photogenic, dramatic, and sweet enough to pause the conversation for a photo. You're the recap.

name: Blue Hawaiian
title: Blue Hawaiian (Tourist on Purpose)
tagline: Main-character vacation energy. No notes. No shame.
description: You did not come to a Hawaiian wedding to be subtle. The drink is blue. You are delighted. You will wear the lei like you earned it, call it "the islands" once, and mean it. Unapologetically touristy. The friend who wants the volcano, the tram, the sign photo, and a tiny umbrella if they have one. People pretending they're too cool for this still live in the Marina and are lying, and you're not doing that this Saturday. You're on vacation. Act like it. Ryan and Natalie threw a wedding in Hawaii. You ordered the drink that looks like Hawaii. That's literacy.
share_text: I got Blue Hawaii. Unapologetically touristy. Main-character vacation energy. The drink is blue and I am thriving.
html_blurb: Unapologetically touristy and thriving. Main-character vacation energy, lei on, no notes.

name: Bikini Blonde Lager
title: Bikini Blonde Lager (Maui Brewing, No Notes)
tagline: You're not here for a rum smoothie and you never were.
description: While everyone else is drinking dessert, you asked what's on tap. Bikini Blonde. Clean. Easy. Actual Maui beer energy. You're low-maintenance in the way that still looks good in photos — just not because you scheduled it. You'll dance, you'll hydrate, you will not have a 9pm sugar crisis. The group chat calls you "chill," which is pure Marina-speak for you have your life together and still showed up. You're not judging the Lava Flows. You're just not becoming one. Ryan and Natalie needed one functional friend this weekend. It's you. Don't make it weird.
share_text: I got Bikini Blonde Lager. Not here for a rum smoothie. Low-maintenance. Maui Brewing energy. I'll be on the lawn.
html_blurb: Chill Maui Brewing energy. Low-maintenance, not here for a rum smoothie, still somehow in every good photo.

name: Off-Resort Modelo
title: Off-Resort Modelo (Be Right Back)
tagline: You clocked the resort prices and chose a walk.
description: You are not paying twenty-something dollars for a beer you can get colder (and cheaper) down the road. This is not a bit. You will vanish with a casual "be right back," return with a Modelo and the smugness of someone who beat the system. Rogue. Resourceful. The friend who still goes out in the Marina but brings a strategy. Ryan and Natalie love you. The bartender has questions. You have a lime and a story. You didn't leave the wedding. You just refused the markup. There's a difference, and you will explain it.
share_text: I got Off-Property Modelo. I saw the resort prices and I will be right back. Don't wait.
html_blurb: Rogue. You clocked the resort prices, said "I'll be right back," and came back winning.

name: Shot of Tequila
title: Shot of Tequila (Chaos, But Make It Love)
tagline: You'll cry at the vows, then ruin the dance floor (affectionately).
description: You are the wedding's chaos agent and its emotional support. You will absolutely cry during the vows — not a cute tear, a real one — then immediately need a shot and a song you can scream. Tequila is not a drink choice. It's a plot device. By 11 you're everyone's favorite problem. By midnight you're telling Ryan he looks so happy. By 1 you're barefoot and insisting this is "so not a tequila night" while holding another one. The group chat already knew. They just didn't expect it before dinner. Natalie sees you. She's not surprised. She's grateful you came.
share_text: I got Shot of Tequila. I will cry at the vows and then hit the dance floor like I have something to prove. I do.
html_blurb: Wedding chaos agent. You'll cry at the vows, take the shot, and become the dance floor's problem — affectionately.

name: Adderall Only
title: Adderall Only (No Drink, Just Vibes)
tagline: You picked the bottom answer on every single question. Efficient. Unsettling.
description: You didn't overthink this quiz. You didn't underthink it either — you just scrolled straight to the last option and picked it, nine times in a row, with the calm, terrifying efficiency of someone who has already made every decision they're making today. You don't need a Mai Tai. You don't need a Lava Flow. You are already vibrating at wedding speed on nothing but pure, unbothered focus. You'll have the seating chart memorized before the appetizers land. You'll know which cousin isn't talking to which cousin by cocktail hour. Ryan and Natalie didn't need a day-of coordinator. They needed you, a note app, and absolutely nothing in a glass. Hydrate anyway.
share_text: I got Adderall Only in Ryan & Natalie's wedding drink quiz. Apparently picking the bottom answer every time means I don't need a drink, I need a nap.
html_blurb: Bottom answer, every question, no hesitation. You don't need a drink — you need a to-do list and a nap.
